title: Null handling and error propagation
description: Defective starter; make the behavior in task.md true without changing the tests. python3 stdlib; pure functions.

starter.provenance: Authored for SDKit F05-A (2026-10). No third-party code. The defects are deliberate: see task.md for the required behavior.

requirements.text: `display_name` returns `profile.full_name` stripped, when it is a non-blank string.
Otherwise (profile missing or `None`, `full_name` missing, `None`, not a string, or blank) it returns the stripped `username`.
If there is no usable username either, or `user` is `None`, it returns `"Unknown user"`. It never raises for dict or `None` input.
`load_display_name` raises `ValueError` when `user_id` is `None`, without calling the repository.
Any other exception raised by the repository is re-raised as `ServiceError` with the original as `__cause__`. It is never swallowed and never turned into an empty string.
`UserNotFound` raised by the repository itself passes through unchanged (not wrapped).
A successful lookup still returns the display name from rules 1 to 3.
